metadata.title: Message Queuing

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for reliable, bounded, asynchronous message delivery between producer and consumer systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Asynchronous message queues supporting delivery guarantees, retries, acknowledgements, and dead-letter handling.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing trust, reliability, and failure handling in point-to-point asynchronous messaging.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Message queuing trust assumes baseline integration identity, ownership, boundary, and accountability guarantees.

metadata.remarks: This pattern captures security-relevant aspects of message queuing systems, including producer and consumer authorization, delivery guarantees, duplication management, poison message handling, and observability. It focuses on how these features shape system behavior and security assumptions without prescribing specific schemas or cryptographic protections.

components.title: Producer and Consumer Authorization
components.description: Ensures only authorized producers may enqueue messages and only authorized consumers may dequeue them.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid service identities to enqueue or dequeue unauthorized messages.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading as an authorized producer or consumer.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding for non-human queue participants.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Queue producers and consumers are authenticated.
Enforcement mechanisms restrict enqueue and dequeue operations.

components.title: Delivery Guarantees and Duplication Management
components.description: Manages delivery semantics to prevent unintended duplicate processing or message loss.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of message handling to cause duplicate or inconsistent processing.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle and retry controls to manage delivery semantics safely.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Queue features are constrained to reduce unsafe delivery behaviors.
Policies define acceptable delivery and retry semantics.

components.title: Poison Message and Dead-Letter Handling
components.description: Prevents repeated processing failures from causing indefinite retries or cascading failure.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through poison messages that block or destabilize consumers.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle controls to isolate and remediate failed messages.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanisms prevent indefinite retention or reprocessing of failed messages.

components.title: Queue Observability and Accountability
components.description: Provides visibility into enqueue, dequeue, retry, and dead-letter activity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to queue misuse or failure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and traceability of queue activity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Queue operations are defined and logged.
Audit review supports investigation of queue-related behavior.
